start.description: The local start of the span, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.

end.description: The local end of the span; an hour after the start where none is given.

seats.description: The fewest seats the resource has; 1 where none is given.

repeat.description: How the span repeats: none, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly.

kind.description: Only the resources of this kind, as a listing names it.
